 "content": "#!/bin/bash\n\n\ncd /Users/sysadmin/Documents/\n\n#VARIABLES\nURL=\"https://upload.zoho.com/workdrive-api/v1/stream/upload\"\nLOG_FILE_PATH=\"/Library/ManageEngine/UEMS_Agent/logs\"\nFILE_NAME=\"$(hostname)_$(date +\"%d-%m-%Y\").zip\"\nWORK_DRIVE_ID=\"gy1s5f14e0f6dde9e401eab0e8ca964174cb1\"\n\n# DON'T MISS USE\nREFRESH_TOKEN=\"1000.4685ab640021242057222d341eaa348c.bafc795bce7c45d348f7697a759930c5\"\nCLIENT_ID=\"1000.8XIMC927L18O3FFJT8R7EJZJTC1G7E\"\nCLIENT_SECRET=\"ed0c28f4987109dd3198d4c09933b0eee600da13e0\"\n\n#COMPRESSING THE LOG FILE\nzip -r $FILE_NAME $LOG_FILE_PATH >/dev/null\n\n# GENERATE ACCESS TOKEN\nresponse=$(curl -s -X POST \"https://accounts.zoho.com/oauth/v2/token?refresh_token=$REFRESH_TOKEN&client_secret=$CLIENT_SECRET&grant_type=refresh_token&client_id=$CLIENT_ID\")\nACCESS_TOKEN=$(echo $response | cut -d\"\\\"\" -f4)\n\n# UPLOAD THE ZIP FILE TO WORKDRIVE\ncurl -X POST \\\n -H \"Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken $ACCESS_TOKEN\" \\\n -H \"x-filename: $FILE_NAME\" \\\n -H \"x-parent_id: $WORK_DRIVE_ID\" \\\n -H \"upload-id: <Unique String for each upload>\" \\\n -H \"x-streammode: 1\" \\\n -F \"file=@./$FILE_NAME;type=application/zip\" \\\n \"$URL\" \\\n >/dev/null 2>&1\n\nif [[ $? == 0 ]]; then\n echo \"Upload Success.\"\nelse\n echo \"Upload Failed.\"\nfi\n\n#CLEAN UP\n\n#Remove zip file which is created\nrm -f $FILE_NAME\necho \"$FILE_NAME has been removed.\"\n\n# Schedule the script to remove itself\nsleep 1 # Slight delay to ensure the script finishes before deletion\n\n# Remove the current script file\n\nrm -vf \"$0\"\necho \"Current script '$0' has been removed.\"\n",
